BREAKING: Nvidia, $NVDA, CEO Jensen Huang reportedly had another affair with a senior Nvidia employee, per NYT.

The relationship was reportedly with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia's VP of Health Care who reports to Jensen Huang.

Witnesses claim that Jensen Huang's security detained a person who “recorded an encounter” between them and offered an NDA.

Nvidia stock is falling sharply on the news.
(@TheKobeissiLetter)

Tal como quando a produtividade agricola ou industrial aumentou 100x

O resultado nao foi uma legiao de desempregados, foi um aumento enorme do nivel de vida e de consumo.
